messages.subject: how to remove this warning
parts:
simulateData(model = semo, model.type = "sem", sample.nobs = 50L)->N50
Warning message:
In simulateData(model = semo, model.type = "sem", sample.nobs = 50L) :
  lavaan WARNING: some regression coefficients are unspecified and will be set to zero

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: how to remove this warning
parts:
On 12/04/2014 11:57 AM, Faran Chohan wrote:
> simulateData(model = semo, model.type = "sem", sample.nobs = 50L)->N50
> Warning message:
> In simulateData(model = semo, model.type = "sem", sample.nobs = 50L) :
> lavaan WARNING: some regression coefficients are unspecified and will
> be set to zero

Just before you call this function, you can set

options(warn = -1)

to turn of (all) warning messages. To switch them back on, type

options(warn = 0)

Yves.
